svg.aria-label: Boss fight: The Judge. Codeforces submissions replayed as Game Boy Tetris
svg.title: Boss fight: The Judge. Codeforces submissions replayed as Game Boy Tetris
svg.desc: Chapter four, boss fight. The ten Codeforces problems that took the most attempts, one column each and one block per submission, fall in the order they were sent. Each accepted submission hits The Judge, whose HP drains to 62 percent. The rating climbs 376, 608, 749, 832 and the full bottom row clears.
